name: California Home Visiting Program
description: The California Home Visiting Program provides free, voluntary home visits to pregnant and newly parenting families facing challenges, offering parenting support, health education, and connections to community resources.
fullDescription: The California Home Visiting Program provides free, voluntary home visits to pregnant and newly parenting families facing challenges, offering parenting support, health education, and connections to community resources.
whatTheyOffer:
- Regular home visits by a Public Health Nurse or trained home visitor
- Parenting education and support
- Child health and development support
- Maternal health and well-being support
- Connections to healthcare and social services
- Visits at home or another agreed-upon location
- Services typically last two to three years
howToGetIt: Contact your local health department or use the state website to find programs in your area. Serves pregnant and newly parenting families with one or more risk factors, such as low income, unstable housing, domestic violence, less than 12 years of education, substance use, or depression/mental health challenges.
keywords: home visiting, nurse, family specialist, pregnant, parenting, child development, breastfeeding, first-time parents, newborn, infant, free visits
